messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Tirzepatide carries a Boxed Warning for the risk of possible thyroid tumors.
Possible Thyroid Tumors (Including Cancer):
Tell your healthcare provider if you get a lump or swelling in your neck, hoarseness, trouble swallowing, or shortness of breath.
These may be symptoms of thyroid cancer.
In studies with rats, tirzepatide and medicines that work like tirzepatide have caused thyroid tumors.
These tumors include thyroid cancer.
It is not known if tirzepatide will cause thyroid tumors.
It is not known if tirzepatide will cause medullary thyroid carcinoma.
Medullary thyroid carcinoma is a type of thyroid cancer.
This applies to people.
Do not use tirzepatide if you or any of your family have ever had a type of thyroid cancer called medullary thyroid carcinoma (MTC).
Do not use tirzepatide if you have an endocrine system condition called Multiple Endocrine Neoplasia syndrome type 2 (MEN 2).
Triplet: ["Medullary thyroid carcinoma", "is a type of", "thyroid cancer"]

The relation 'is a type of' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject entity is a specific type or subtype of the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'include': The object entity is a type or example of the subject entity.
B. 'is a': The subject entity is categorized as the object entity.
C. 'is one of most widely prescribed': The subject entity is among the most commonly prescribed entities of the type specified by the object entity.
D. 'vary by': The subject entity differs depending on the object entity.
E. 'are copies of': The subject entity is a synthetic or artificial version of the entity specified by the object entity.
